**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `outward()` (crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs) flips the sign-canonical plane normal by the summed facet winding. Triangle lookups use `tris.get`, there is no unwrap or indexing, and a face whose winding sums to nothing keeps the canonical normal. That is a safe fallback.
- The geometry crate and face ids are untouched. The change is small and sits in the MCP read path only.
- The new test `list_features_facing_follows_the_outward_side` pins the bug (1 up, 1 down, 4 side; bottom normal -Z).
- The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #884`.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_pick`: 5 passed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_setup`: 6 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The `Changelog:` line still reads `PR #M`. Fill in `#947` at the cut.
- STEP import was not exercised, as the body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0b14479dbc6092b50d439a8487706da8c7784dc5 -->
**Independent review** (second pair of eyes; the PR was only self-reviewed before). Verdict: **Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- `outward()` (`crates/app/src/mcp/features.rs`) flips the canonical plane normal to the side the face's summed facet winding points at, and `facing` derives from it. This is the same arithmetic `pick::align::outward_normal` uses (cross-product sum dotted with the plane normal), so list rows and the mate tools agree on every closed, outward-wound solid.
- Pinned by `list_features_facing_follows_the_outward_side` (cylinder boss + box: 1 up, 1 down, 4 side; bottom normal -Z). A zero-area / empty / non-finite winding sum compares false and keeps the canonical normal, so no panic.
- No process-file change: the camcraft-mcp skill has no note about this caveat.

Local results (merged with main a6bd69d8, clean merge)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_pick`: 5 passed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_setup`: 6 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (non-blocking)
- This is a second derivation: `outward_normal` additionally runs the closed-and-outward-wound verdict (`pick/winding.rs`, #366) and refuses an open or inverted shell by name, while `outward()` still reports a winding-based side for such a shell. The mate tools refuse there, so no wrong frame is posted, but the list can show "down" for a face whose shell is inverted. Reusing the winding verdict (and showing a refusal-shaped field) is what #956's Done means asks for; a follow-up is fine.
- Closing #956: this PR fixes the same defect for planar faces (box sides pair up opposite) but the body lists only `Fixes #884`. #956 also asks for the undecidable-winding field, so leave it open or add `Refs #956`, maintainer's call.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
